authorization: Publisher authorised three verified daily company-analysis articles on 2 November 2026, superseding the repository's one-new-article daily cap.
story_thesis: CVS's segments have distinct economic profiles, but the proposed separation only creates value if standalone margins, cash generation and debt allocation remain sound.

identity.units: USD millions except membership, claims, prescriptions and per-share data

duplicate_checks: Checked both editorial inventories and actual wealth content; CVS had a maintained stock profile but no separation-and-segment-economics analysis.
Checked open PRs, recent merged publication PRs, company-publication records and live content; no matching CVS story or fingerprint was active.
Checked the 5 November Europe/Dublin scheduled publication count before drafting; no scheduled company-analysis article had been published.
The article assesses the proposed structure rather than recapping the quarter; routine figures remain on /stocks/cvs/.
candidate_review_reference: See 3ae41b5b0decee371a9e8bfc.json for the ten-company screen; CVS was selected independently.

evidence_table.claim: CVS intends a tax-free separation into healthcare-solutions and retail/community-health companies in H1 2028, subject to conditions.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release strategic announcement and 10-Q subsequent-events disclosure; transaction consistently described as proposed.
evidence_table.result: verified; completion and debt allocation not assumed

evidence_table.claim: Total revenue was USD108.399bn and adjusted operating income USD4.194bn, up 5.4% and 21.2%.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release consolidated table and 10-Q segment reconciliation.

evidence_table.claim: Health Care Benefits revenue was USD36.855bn, adjusted operating income USD912m and MBR 91.3%.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Segment tables; prior USD314m income and 92.8% MBR independently rechecked.

evidence_table.claim: Health Services revenue rose 9.5% to USD53.964bn while adjusted operating income rose 2.7% to USD2.106bn.
Pharmacy & Consumer Wellness revenue fell 2.0% to USD35.498bn while adjusted operating income rose 10.6% to USD1.635bn.
Nine-month OCF was USD15.318bn, capex USD2.357bn, debt repayment USD4.057bn, cash USD11.738bn and long-term debt USD57.223bn.
Prior-year GAAP operating loss included a USD5.725bn goodwill impairment.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release reconciliation and 10-Q goodwill note; excluded from like-for-like operating interpretation.

fact_check_pass.method: Every material number, period, segment classification, separation condition, GAAP/non-GAAP measure, management explanation and calculation was reread against the SEC-furnished release and Form 10-Q; arithmetic was recomputed independently.
